title: Alignment at Pre-training! Towards Native Alignment for Arabic LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment with Arabic culture, values, and societal norms using the ACVA (Arabic Cultural Value Alignment) benchmark and the AraTrust evaluation framework.

Measuring hate speech, harassment, and violence using the OpenAI Moderation API, and prompting GPT-4 as a judge to evaluate responses on the BeaverTails dataset for discrimination and offensive language against specific groups.
